title: Anomalous suppression of quantum chaos between two integrable limits
summary: Level statistics in non-integrable quantum many-body systems with time reversal symmetry are expected to follow the Gaussian Orthogonal Ensemble (GOE), a hallmark of quantum chaos. However, we show that the interacting Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model exhibits a clear suppression of the mean level-spacing ratio $\langle r\rangle$ from the GOE value $\approx 0.535$, persisting deep in the nonintegrable regime.
